text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 164, September 24, 1938 ]
TEMPORARILY CLOSING THE PORT OF CEBU AS A PORT OF ENTRY TO IMMIGRANTS COMING
TO THE PHILIPPINES
It having been reported to me by the Secretary of Labor that the number of immigrants entering the port of
Cebu far exceeds the facilities existing therein for the adequate accommodation of detained immigrants and
the proper administration of immigration laws, I, MANUEL L. QUEZON, President of the Philippines, upon
recommendation of the Secretary of Labor and by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby order
that the port of Cebu be closed as a port of entry to immigrants coming to the Philippines, effective on
November one, nineteen hundred and thirty-eight, and until such time as proper facilities for the
above-mentioned purposes can be provided therein.
Done at the City of Manila, this twenty-fourth day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and thirty-eight, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the third.
MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
JORGE B. VARGAS
Secretary to the President
